name: Lacustrine-Scree
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond an exposed planetary core the sky stays the color of a bruise.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
